nom: TATCHA Indigo Overnight Repair Redness Reducing Barrier Cream

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reports a severe breakout and stopped use after consulting a dermatologist.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report relief from dryness, flaky patches, and dehydration, with several calling it a lifesaver for winter dryness, though one dry-skin user still saw breakouts.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report reduced redness and balanced oil, with one long-time acne-prone combination-skin user calling results 'sorcery' despite initial hesitation.
segments.sensitive: The largest group of reviewers identify as sensitive, often with rosacea, eczema or psoriasis, and overwhelmingly report calming of irritation and redness with no new sensitivity, though a few sensitive-skin users report breakouts, migraines, or eye swelling.
segments.mature: One reviewer with sensitive mature skin reports improved feel and appearance; another long-time user in her 60s calls it excellent against dryness and signs of aging.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers mention firmer skin, plumping, and reduced fine lines from dryness; only one review discusses wrinkles directly and reports visible improvement.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report significant moisture increase, disappearance of flaky patches, and softness lasting into the morning.
concerns.redness: The majority of reviewers focused on redness (often rosacea-related) report visible reduction, sometimes within one use; a minority report no improvement or worsened redness after a rosacea flare.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the cream with repairing or strengthening their skin barrier and healing eczema or chemical-burn-like irritation within days; one reviewer doubted the barrier claim initially but was convinced after use.
concerns.spots: One review mentions reduced appearance of dark spots and hyperpigmentation alongside brightening, but this is not corroborated elsewhere in the set.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, mostly with oily or acne-prone skin, report new breakouts including cystic acne and whiteheads; one acne-prone reviewer reports the opposite, no new breakouts and calmer skin.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer describes a greasy, oily residue transferring to pillow and hands alongside itchiness; another describes the same cream as absorbing without any greasy feel.

aspects.libelle: Greasy residue on skin or hands

extraits.texte: Sadly, this cream was the cause of my recent horrible break out. I was hoping to make this my new permanent night cream over my retinol. As soon as I stopped it my skin started clearing up with no new pimples. Even went to the dermatologist over it. I do have oily, acne prone skin. So be mindful if you have that skin type. Thankfully was able to return it.

extraits.titre: Thought it would help with redness from rosacea flare
extraits.texte: I really wanted to love this product line ,but unfortunately it made my rosacea worse and broke my face out bad. The first couple days i thought it was trying to work but had to stop after a week and a half, my skin was freaking out.

Sadly my skin loves this so much! I have tried a lot of similiar products and nothing compares to this. I have very sensitive acne prone skin and I get dry patches. I feel like its over priced, but when I use it my skin is mosturized and no reddness or irritation. I have never found a product tha comes close to this.

I am 69 years old and I have very sensitive skin My face was frequently red and irritated before I started using Indigo Overnight Repair This is the first product I have used that eliminated both the irritation and redness

extraits.titre: Only tatcha cream that doesn't irritate my sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I went through 5 jars of this and I bought five more when there were 5x the points. My sensitive skin with rosacea needs this cream. Its thick and good for the winter. In the summer I use prequel am pm moisturizer or the anua rice moistrurizing milk.

I have combo skin that is sometimes sensitive with a history of hormonal and cystic acne so I was reluctant to use something different than my beloved Water Cream at night But everyone is talking about the skin barrier and how important it is to strengthen it and Tatcha's products do what they say they will do so I thought I would give it a try And let me tell you there is some kind of sorcery in this little blue jar because every time I use it the next morning my face looks rejuvenated and just better all over I get excited at night when I use this because I know I will see results in the morning In fact if I am too tired to do any other skin care I at least put this on at night because I know it will improve my skin while I am sleeping And it feels so good to put on I apply it after my other Tatcha products and it's so rich and creamy I feel like it seals my other serums in and gets to work while I sleep Magic

Wow I was a little skeptical about this restoring my skin barrier but this stuff is amazing After a week of vacation in the sun my skin was stinging with all my products This was the only thing I could put on my skin that didnt sting at all! After just two nights my dry damaged skin was so much better This stuff is worth every penny
